spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'purchase')
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'view_item'), 0)
  , 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM events;

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', event_timestamp) AS day,
  event_name,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM events
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

WITH cart_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ga_session_id FROM events WHERE event_name = 'add_to_cart'
),
purchased_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ga_session_id FROM events WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart_sessions WHERE ga_session_id NOT IN (SELECT ga_session_id FROM purchased_sessions))
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart_sessions), 0)
  , 2) AS cart_abandonment_pct;

SELECT item_category, COUNT(*) AS views
FROM events
WHERE event_name IN ('view_item', 'purchase') AND item_category IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY item_category
ORDER BY views DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT traffic_source_name AS campaign, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM events
WHERE traffic_source_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY traffic_source_name
ORDER BY events DESC;

SELECT
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM event_timestamp) AS hour_of_day,
  TO_CHAR(event_timestamp, 'Dy') AS day_of_week,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM events
GROUP BY hour_of_day, day_of_week
ORDER BY hour_of_day;

SELECT
  date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS "time",
  topic,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM events
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  device_category || ' / ' || device_os AS device_os,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) AS sessions
FROM events
WHERE device_category IS NOT NULL AND device_os IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY device_category, device_os
ORDER BY sessions DESC;

WITH city_events AS (
  SELECT geo_city AS city, COUNT(*) AS event_count
  FROM events
  WHERE geo_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geo_city
)
SELECT
  city,
  event_count,
  CASE city
    WHEN 'Mumbai' THEN 19.0760
    WHEN 'Delhi' THEN 28.7041
    WHEN 'Bengaluru' THEN 12.9716
    WHEN 'Pune' THEN 18.5204
    WHEN 'Chennai' THEN 13.0827
    WHEN 'Hyderabad' THEN 17.3850
    WHEN 'Kolkata' THEN 22.5726
    WHEN 'Ahmedabad' THEN 23.0225
    WHEN 'Jaipur' THEN 26.9124
    WHEN 'Lucknow' THEN 26.8467
  END AS latitude,
  CASE city
    WHEN 'Mumbai' THEN 72.8777
    WHEN 'Delhi' THEN 77.1025
    WHEN 'Bengaluru' THEN 77.5946
    WHEN 'Pune' THEN 73.8567
    WHEN 'Chennai' THEN 80.2707
    WHEN 'Hyderabad' THEN 78.4867
    WHEN 'Kolkata' THEN 88.3639
    WHEN 'Ahmedabad' THEN 72.5714
    WHEN 'Jaipur' THEN 75.7873
    WHEN 'Lucknow' THEN 80.9462
  END AS longitude
FROM city_events
WHERE city IN ('Mumbai','Delhi','Bengaluru','Pune','Chennai','Hyderabad','Kolkata','Ahmedabad','Jaipur','Lucknow')
ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', event_timestamp) AS "time",
  COUNT(*) AS purchases
FROM events
WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
